summary: Opening entry for the Ridge Loop. Seeded, but the group has fewer embodied slots than the Coast Path, which is why the expansion heuristic does not choose it.

entry.location_note: Leaves the coast path at the second stile and climbs to the saddle.
what_to_look_for: The bay comes into view all at once at the top of the rise.
Drystone field boundaries that predate the current path.
entry.accessibility: Sustained climb with one stile; no wheeled access.
entry.takeaway: Shortest route to a view of the whole bay, at the cost of the only real ascent in the guide.

notes: Fictional example content written for the Argus demo.
